description: pkix-lint/src/cabf_tls_br.rs:271-327: rsa_modulus_byte_len, der_peel_tlv, der_tlv_value_len, parse_der_length implement manual DER parsing to measure the RSA modulus. pkix-path/src/lib.rs:1813: rsa_public_key_bits is a private function doing essentially the same job using UintRef from the der crate. The lint uses raw byte counting (n_bytes >= 256) while pkix-path uses magnitude bytes (produces 2048 for a 2048-bit key). Having two implementations is a maintenance burden: any fix to the comparison logic must be applied in two places. Suggested: expose rsa_public_key_bits as pub(crate) or as a pub function in a pkix-crypto-util crate, then use it from both sites.
notes: rsa_public_key_bits in pkix-path is private and returns bits; cabf_tls_br needs bytes and different semantics. Could expose as pub, but adds public surface. Deferred.
title: cabf_tls_br.rs duplicates RSA modulus parsing; pkix-path already has rsa_public_key_bits
